response.incident_summary: The checkout-service experienced a high error rate alert (ev_alert_001) triggered at 2026-06-28T13:43:39.605022Z. Log template ev_log_template_003 indicates a payment dependency was repeatedly unavailable after retries (40 occurrences, 28.4% of logs). Simultaneously, metrics show a 1000% increase in payment_dependency_failures_total (ev_metric_006) and http_request_errors_total (ev_metric_002), alongside a 1000% jump in request_error_rate (ev_metric_003) and large latency increases (ev_metric_004, ev_metric_005). All evidence links to the same entity (checkout-service, pod checkout-api-7c9d, cncc-demo-12345).

primary_hypothesis.claim: A payment dependency failure is the likely cause of the observed HTTP 503 errors and elevated error rate.

domain_reasoning.fault_events: ev_alert_001 defines the incident trigger and describes a synthetic payment dependency failure causing HTTP 503s.
domain_reasoning.log_text: ev_log_template_003 (40 logs) shows repeated payment dependency unavailability after retries, directly preceding the alert.
domain_reasoning.time_series_metrics: ev_metric_006 (payment_dependency_failures_total) spikes 1000% and ev_metric_002 (http_request_errors_total) spikes 1000%, both exactly at the alert timestamp.
domain_reasoning.topology_metadata: All evidence entities match (checkout-service, demo-cluster, checkout-api-7c9d, cncc-demo-12345), confirming the scope is confined to this pod and service.
